jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1533905&fc.title: Intern - Junction

raw_source_fields.education: Additional Requirements

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1533905&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors degree (minimum requirement) in any relevant discipline from a reputed university. Only candidates who have already graduated will be considered. Additional Requirements Freshers are encouraged to apply. CORE COMPETENCIES Capability to support the planning and coordination of Junctions programs, including Incurator (incubation) and the School of Entrepreneurship (SoE). Ability to assist with secondary research, case documentation, and briefs for Junctions R&D and Research Fellowship activities. Ability to coordinate communication with founders, mentors, and partner organizations across Junctions entrepreneurial ecosystem. Ability to support documentation for Junctions Intellectual Property (IP) and Compliance & Investment Readiness portfolios. Capability to help organize workshops, cohort sessions, pitch events, and other Junction activities. Ability to contribute content for Junctions Blogs & Case Lab (cases, podcasts, teaching notes). Excellent competency in using MS Office and Google Workspace for documentation and reporting. Perfect command of both English and Bangla, in written and verbal communication. Responsibilities & Context ABOUT US: iSocial is a policy-driven, for-profit social enterprise delivering impact through data-driven insights, strategic advocacy, and innovative digital solutions. iSocial operates through three Strategic Business Units: DataSense – Research, policy, and data analytics arm. Junction Bangladesh – Venture studio and ecosystem-building unit supporting startups and enterprises. iSkill – A digital platform transforming TVET institutions through blended learning. JOB OVERVIEW Junction Bangladesh is looking for a motivated Intern to support its entrepreneurship development work. The selected candidate will work directly within Junctions core team, assisting across incubation, research, and ecosystem-building activities. The role demands coordination, curiosity, and a genuine interest in entrepreneurship and innovation. INTERNSHIP TERMS This is a 4-month internship, extendable based on mutual discussion between the intern and management. Interns who perform well may be offered a full-time position within the organization, subject to the managements discretion and business needs. JOB NATURE AND MODALITY Full-time (Sunday through Thursday) CORE DUTY STATION The interns core duty and reporting line will be within Junction Bangladesh. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Case Management Compliance Coordination Documentation Google Sheets Compensation & Other Benefits Monthly remuneration of BDT 10,000 Subsidized lunch. Compensatory leave for working extra hours and weekends or holidays. Professional exposure to national and international development and ecosystem initiatives. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

In compliance with the applicable circulars/instructions of Bangladesh Bank, successful completion of the required Banking Professional Examination (JAIBB/AIBB, as applicable) is mandatory for consideration of an offer at the next job grade. Responsibilities & Context Manage and coordinate day-to-day HR & Administrative activities of the factory. Maintain and update HR & Administrative records, registers, and documentation (Factory & Govt. Related) accurately and timely. Monitor manpower requirements, recruitment, attendance, and payroll processing. Ensure adequate, capable, and efficient manpower deployment across departments. Maintain a positive working environment and ensure smooth factory operations. Coordinate with government and non-government offices as required. Assist in implementing HR policies, training programs, and employee development initiatives. Coordinate administrative support services, bill verification, and timely payment recommendations. Manage and monitor factory canteen operations, ensuring food quality, hygiene, and employee satisfaction. Coordinate company vehicle management and related administrative matters. Perform any other duties assigned by management. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1534925&fc.source_content: Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Public Administration, or another relevant discipline from a recognized institution. Preferred: Training or certification in Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or Office Management will be an advantage. Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Experience – Essential Minimum 1 years of relevant experience in administration, logistics, operations, office management, or related fields. Experience supporting administrative documentation and filing. Experience in logistics coordination, asset management, or inventory management. Experience using Microsoft Office applications. Experience maintaining records and tracking documents. Desirable Previous experience working with NGOs, INGOs, or humanitarian organizations. Experience working in a healthcare facility, PHCC, hospital, Field Hospital, or humanitarian health programme. Previous experience in the Rohingya Response or other humanitarian settings. Experience supporting emergency or field operations. Experience working in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment. Skills & Competencies Technical Skills Basic knowledge of administration and logistics procedures. Understanding of filing and record management. Basic knowledge of asset and inventory management. Understanding of procurement request and supply follow-up processes. Basic understanding of transport and facility coordination. Good knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. Planning & Organizational Skills Good organizational and time management skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. Strong attention to detail. Ability to follow instructions and organizational procedures. Good follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure. Communication & Interpersonal Skills Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with different teams. Good documentation skills. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment. Good written and spoken English and Bangla. Other Competencies High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism. Strong attention to accuracy and detail. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Commitment to responsible use of organizational resources. Ability to work in a challenging and fast-paced humanitarian environment. Cultural sensitivity and respect for affected populations. Flexibility and willingness to support emergency operations. Working Conditions The position will be based at a Primary Health Care Centre (PHCC) in the Rohingya Response, Cox’s Bazar. The position holder will provide administrative and logistical support to PHCC operations. The role may involve coordination with multiple clinical and support teams. The position holder may be required to move between PHCC facilities and other programme locations based on operational needs. The role involves working in a challenging and fast-paced humanitarian healthcare environment. The position holder may be required to support activities outside regular working hours during emergencies or critical operational requirements. Responsibilities & Context Position Summary The Assistant Officer – Admin & Logistics will provide administrative and logistical support to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the Primary Health Care Centre (PHCC) in the Rohingya Response, Cox’s Bazar. The position holder will support day-to-day administrative activities, logistics coordination, documentation, filing, asset and inventory management, transport arrangements, procurement follow-up, facility maintenance, and other operational requirements. The Assistant Officer – Admin & Logistics will work under the supervision of the Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics and closely coordinate with the Clinical Coordinator, Medical Officer Lead, Medical Warehouse, Pharmacy, Laboratory, Nursing, Midwifery, IPC, Surveillance, Finance, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Security, WASH, and other relevant teams to support uninterrupted and effective PHCC service delivery. Duty Station: Camp 5 & 21, Cox’s Bazar Reports to: Senior Officer Admin & Logistics Accountable to: Deputy Project Coordinator KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY: Administrative Support Provide day-to-day administrative support to PHCC operations. Assist in preparing letters, notices, memos, meeting minutes, and other official documents. Maintain proper filing systems for administrative and operational documents. Support the preparation and distribution of internal communications. Maintain and organize electronic and physical records. Assist in scheduling meetings and coordinating administrative arrangements. Support follow-up of routine administrative action points. Receive and distribute official documents and correspondence as assigned. Maintain confidentiality of organizational and staff information. Meeting, Training & Event Support Support logistical arrangements for meetings, trainings, workshops, and orientations. Prepare meeting rooms and ensure required materials are available. Assist with participant registration and attendance records. Support preparation and distribution of meeting materials. Assist in documenting meeting minutes and action points when assigned. Coordinate refreshments and other approved logistical arrangements. Support follow-up on agreed action points. Ensure training and meeting venues are properly arranged. Logistics Coordination Support Provide day-to-day logistical support for PHCC activities. Assist in coordinating the movement and delivery of approved supplies and materials. Follow up on routine logistical requests. Coordinate with relevant teams regarding operational requirements. Support timely delivery of non-medical supplies to designated locations. Assist in tracking pending logistical requests. Report delays or logistical constraints to the Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics. Support logistics arrangements for programme and emergency activities. Procurement Request & Follow-up Support Assist PHCC teams in preparing procurement requests according to organizational procedures. Ensure requests contain required specifications and supporting documents. Maintain a tracking record of submitted procurement requests. Follow up with Procurement and Supply Chain teams regarding request status. Communicate updates on approved requests to relevant teams. Support receiving and checking of general supplies and equipment. Maintain relevant procurement-related records. Escalate delayed or urgent requests to the supervisor. Asset Management Support Assist in maintaining accurate PHCC asset records. Support asset tagging and registration. Maintain asset movement and handover records. Assist in periodic physical verification of assets. Monitor the location and condition of assigned assets. Report damaged, missing, or lost assets promptly. Support asset handover and return processes. Maintain supporting documentation related to assets. Assist during asset audits and verification exercises. General Store & Non-Medical Supply Management Assist in maintaining stock records for general office and non-medical supplies. Monitor the availability of stationery, office materials, cleaning supplies, and other approved non-medical items. Support proper storage and organization of supplies. Assist in receiving and issuing general supplies. Maintain stock issue and receipt records. Support periodic physical stock counts. Report shortages, damaged items, and stock discrepancies. Support timely replenishment of essential non-medical supplies. Transport & Movement Support Assist in coordinating transport requests for PHCC staff and activities. Maintain transport request records. Support communication with drivers and transport focal persons. Assist with scheduling approved staff movement and field visits. Follow up on vehicle availability. Communicate transport schedules to relevant staff. Support emergency transportation arrangements when assigned. Report transport constraints or delays to the supervisor. Facility & Office Support Support routine monitoring of PHCC offices and common operational areas. Identify basic maintenance and repair requirements. Report facility-related concerns to the Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics. Assist in following up on maintenance and repair requests. Monitor basic office and facility requirements, including furniture and equipment. Support arrangements for workspace and office facilities. Assist in maintaining a clean, organized, and functional working environment. Report damaged or unsafe equipment and facilities promptly. Utilities & Operational Services Support monitoring of essential operational services, including: o Electricity and backup power. o Water supply. o Lighting. o Ventilation. o Communication and internet services, where applicable. Report service interruptions or technical problems promptly. Assist in following up with relevant teams for restoration of services. Maintain relevant operational records when assigned. Support contingency arrangements during utility disruptions. Documentation & Record Management Maintain accurate and organized administrative and logistics records. Support proper filing of: o Procurement requests. o Asset records. o General stock records. o Transport requests. o Maintenance requests. o Meeting records. o Visitor records. o Administrative correspondence. Maintain both electronic and physical filing systems. Ensure documents are properly labelled and accessible to authorized personnel. Maintain confidentiality and security of organizational documents. Visitor & Reception Support Support the administrative management of official visitors. Maintain visitor records where applicable. Assist with arrangements for official meetings and visits. Provide basic administrative support during monitoring and official visits. Coordinate logistical arrangements for visitors when assigned. Ensure relevant staff are informed about scheduled official visits. Support appropriate access procedures for visitors. Coordination with PHCC Teams Work closely with the Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics and other PHCC teams. Coordinate with Pharmacy, Medical Warehouse, Laboratory, Nursing, Midwifery, IPC, Surveillance, and other teams regarding routine administrative and logistics requirements. Liaise with HR, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Security, and other support departments. Support communication and follow-up between PHCC and support teams. Participate in relevant meetings when assigned. Communicate operational challenges and delays to the supervisor. Safety, Security & Health Support Follow organizational health, safety, and security procedures. Identify and report workplace hazards and unsafe conditions. Support basic facility safety measures. Ensure emergency exits and access routes are kept clear. Support the maintenance of safety notices and emergency information. Report security concerns promptly. Coordinate with Security and relevant teams when assigned. Support emergency preparedness activities. Support logistics arrangements during disease outbreaks, fires, natural disasters, mass casualty incidents, and other emergencies. Assist with emergency transportation and movement arrangements when assigned. Support continuity of essential administrative and logistical services. Participate in emergency preparedness activities and drills. Remain flexible to undertake additional responsibilities during emergency response. raw_source_fields.education: Additional Requirements

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535072&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree (BBA/MBA) with 2+ years in tactical/urgent procurement. Additional Requirements Pre-requisite to apply: Proficiency in SAP/Oracle ERP systems and strong MS Excel skills for managing procurement workflows. Strong vendor/supplier management, market analysis, commercial awareness, and a cost-conscious, analytical mindset. Proven negotiation, high-pressure execution for urgent/multiple requirements, thorough documentation, and steady follow-up. Strong communication skills paired with high integrity, confidentiality, and strict adherence to ethical procurement practices. Responsibilities & Context SQUARE Pharmaceuticals PLC., the flagship company of SQUARE Group and certified by major international pharmaceutical regulatory authorities, is holding the 1st position in the pharmaceutical industry among all national and multinational companies of Bangladesh since 1985. SQUARE Pharmaceuticals PLC. has become a global player starting its operation in Kenya. Right now we are looking for smart, energetic and result oriented team members, who will share with us our pride and support our continuous growth. If you think you have what it takes to be a member of SQUARE, do not wait to apply as: Officer, Local Procurement, Supply Chain Management Work Station: Corpoprate Headquaters Major Duties and Responsibilities: Fast-track urgent procurement for IT, engineering, and office supplies to maintain uninterrupted operations. Build a reliable supplier network, gather multi-quote bids, and negotiate optimal prices, warranties, and delivery terms. Track market trends, drive cost savings, and convert repetitive spot buys into structured, long-term supply contracts. Partner with Engineering, IT, Production, and Warehouse teams to verify technical specs and validate emergency justifications. Issue Purchase Orders (POs), build audit-ready documentation, and enforce strict adherence to company SCM policy. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills ERP Systems Logistics Management Supply Chain Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Range: Attractive remuneration package will be offered Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535103&fc.title: Media Buyer & Performance Marketing Specialist

raw_source_fields.age: ncy, Advertising Technology (AdTech) Startup Additional Requirements

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535103&fc.source_content:
Requirements Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, Advertising Technology (AdTech) Startup Additional Requirements Age At least 20 years Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Media Buying / Performance Marketing. Previous experience managing at least USD 500/day in paid advertising is required. Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads. Experience with TikTok and YouTube Ads will be preferred. Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion funnels, retargeting and campaign scaling. Practical knowledge of Meta Pixel, CAPI, GA4, GTM and conversion tracking. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of campaign performance. Most importantly, you must be able to show real previous work and results . We want to know which companies or brands you have worked with, how much budget you managed and what results you achieved. Performance Bonus / KPI This is a result-driven role . Performance Bonus/KPI will be based on measurable results such as: Lead Quality Cost Per Qualified Lead Cost Per Acquisition / Conversion Conversion Rate ROAS Overall Advertising Efficiency The goal is not simply to spend the budget. The goal is to generate better business results from every advertising dollar spent. Responsibilities & Context About the Role Deyal Ltd. is looking for an experienced Media Buyer & Performance Marketing Specialist to take ownership of our paid advertising across Facebook, Instagram, Google, YouTube, TikTok and other relevant platforms . Our daily advertising budget can reach USD 1,000 , so we need someone who is already comfortable managing significant ad spend and making decisions based on data. We are not looking for someone who only knows how to set up campaigns. We need someone who can understand what is working, identify where money is being wasted, test new strategies and scale campaigns that produce results. What You’ll Do Plan, launch, optimize and scale paid advertising campaigns. Manage daily ad budgets of up to USD 1,000 . Build lead generation, conversion and retargeting campaigns. Research audiences, competitors and new opportunities. Test different audiences, offers, creatives and campaign strategies. Monitor CPL, CPA, conversion rate, ROAS and lead quality. Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action quickly. Scale successful campaigns while maintaining efficiency. Work closely with the Creative Team and provide direction on what creatives, hooks and offers should be tested. Maintain accurate tracking through Meta Pixel, CAPI, GA4, GTM and other relevant tools. Prepare clear performance reports and recommend what should be tested or improved next. Skills & Expertise Digital Media Buying facebook ads Google Ads Lead Generation Media Buying Media Planning/ Media Buying YouTube Marketing Other Relevant Skills Marketing Performance Marketing Compensation & Other Benefits Tour allowance,Performance bonus Festival Bonus: 1 Salary Review: Yearly Performance Bonus/KPI: Based on actual results Final salary will depend on experience, previous advertising budget managed and proven campaign results. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
Job Context
ENaturalMart is a growing ecommerce marketplace focused on natural and authentic products. We are looking for an energetic, smart, and target-oriented Business Development Officer (BDO) to support our business expansion.
The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying potential vendors and business opportunities, onboarding new vendors, developing relationships, and supporting the growth of ENaturalMart's marketplace.
Job Responsibilities
Vendor Acquisition & Business Development
Identify and approach potential vendors, manufacturers, farmers, producers, brands, and suppliers of natural products.
Conduct vendor outreach through phone calls, email, social media, online research, and field visits when required.
Explain ENaturalMart's marketplace model, benefits, commercial terms, and onboarding process to potential vendors.
Negotiate pricing, commission, payment terms, product availability, and other business conditions with vendors.
Maintain strong and professional relationships with existing and prospective vendors.
Follow up regularly with potential vendors until successful onboarding.
Identify new product categories and business opportunities for ENaturalMart.
Research competitors, suppliers, markets, and emerging natural-product trends.
Vendor Onboarding & Product Coordination
Collect vendor information, product details, pricing, product images, documents, and other required
information.
Coordinate with the operations and technical team to complete vendor onboarding.
Ensure product information is accurate and complete before listing.
Monitor vendor responsiveness, product availability, pricing, and service quality.
Maintain an updated vendor database and follow-up records.
Business Communication & Negotiation
Communicate professionally with vendors in both Bangla and English.
Conduct business negotiations confidently and professionally.
Build long-term relationships with vendors and business partners.
Handle vendor questions and coordinate internally to resolve issues.
Reporting & Office Work
Prepare daily and weekly business development reports.
Maintain vendor databases using MS Excel / Google Sheets.
Prepare presentations, documents, emails, and business proposals using MS Office.
Maintain records of leads, follow-ups, meetings, negotiations, and conversions.
Internet & AI Utilization
Use the internet effectively for vendor research, market research, competitor analysis, and lead generation.
Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant AI tools to improve research, communication, reporting, data analysis, and productivity.
Demonstrate willingness to learn and adopt new digital and AI-powered tools
Compensation & Other Benefits
Performance-based incentives.
Career growth opportunities.
Opportunity to work with a growing ecommerce and natural-products marketplace.
Opportunity to develop practical skills in ecommerce, business development, digital tools, and AI.

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS)
raw_source_fields.age: 22 to 32 years Responsibilities & Context Company Description:- Bangladesh Psychiatric Care Ltd. (BPCL) is the first comprehensive psychiatric consultation center in Bangladesh, offering international standard mental health services under one roof. With a mission to deliver one-stop solutions for all mental health needs, BPCL addresses a wide range of psychiatric disorders, psychological challenges, and psycho-social issues. The experienced team of globally recognized and emerging psychiatrists, along with expert psychotherapists, provides world-class treatment, management, and rehabilitation services. Located in Dhaka, BPCL emphasizes quality care for a better quality of life and is committed to raising the standard of mental health care in the region. Job Summary:- The Jr. Business Development Executive will be responsible for supporting the growth and expansion initiatives of Bangladesh Psychiatric Care Ltd. by developing strategic relationships, promoting healthcare services, identifying business opportunities, and assisting in marketing and client engagement activities. The incumbent will work closely with internal teams to enhance organizational visibility and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, healthcare professionals, institutions, and stakeholders.

Responsibilities & Context Managing overall office administration and ensuring smooth daily operations. Maintaining proper books of accounts, vouchers, bills, invoices, and supporting documents. Handling cash, bank deposits, withdrawals, and cheque-related activities. Managing petty cash and preparing regular petty cash statements. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1534042&fc.title: Transaction Service Officer, Retail Distribution, Retail Banking

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor/Honors
raw_source_fields.age: 24 to 32 years Responsibilities & Context Execution of Transaction: Cash receive from customer and payment to customer with proper checking and counting of physical cash through manual and machine support (counting machine). Posting of all transactions in core banking software as per delegation. Execute Islami Banking transactions (receipt/payment) through IB software (Ababil) and core software. Receiving clearing & collection cheques and maintaining clearing/collection cheque inward/outward register. Process clearing cheque through related software (MICR & BACH). Act as clearing house representative of branch. Physically present at clearing house for local clearing at Sonali Bank for rural branches. Remittance to local Feeding bank (Sonali bank as representative of Bangladesh Bank) and other bank branches maintaining process guidelines. Assistance to chief teller in collection, Selling & purchasing of prize bond and preservation of stamps for internal use. FCY currency transaction. Collection of utility bills (PDB/WASA etc). Collection of various fees of BRTA through separate BRTA software and reporting including posting at core software at day end. Maintenance and exchange of coins and mutilated notes at cash counters. Sorting of cash manually as per process for onward payment and remittance to feeding branch/Bangladesh bank. Active support to chief teller for cash management at branch ATM & CDM. Support to various offsite collection (ie; CR Booth at Airport) booths. Cash/Prize Bond/Stamp collection and delivery to various branches as per their requisition/requirement by the Feeding branches. Act as Chief of Transaction Service in case of leave of Chief of Transaction Service. Ensure Customer Service: Ensuring responses to customer queries at cash counter regarding their accounts. Ensuring fasts possible transaction with accuracy to maintain appropriate queue management (EQM). Ensure SLA is maintained for each and every transaction services provided to customer. Ensure faster service to large customers of Corporate and Commercial and SME division. Ensure service to collection accounts (GP/Bkash/Alico etc) of Cash Management through related separate software. Ensuring Compliance & Regulatory Requirements: Check all instruments for validity and acceptability and decline transaction that involves false or confusing information. Checking and confirmation of all cheque placed in the counter through various related software (MICR) and phone calls before payment. Inform any suspicious transaction to the upper management of the branch immediately. Inform customer and CS team for TP update requirement of the customers. Completing proper KYC at counter for walk-in customers transactions needs. Cross checking of daily cash transactions and delivery of daily vouchers to CSM for final tally for submission to branch operation member. Daily reconciliation of all transactions. Ensure smooth service for External, Internal & Statutory Audit Inspection time to count physical cash. Promote, Educate and Advise Customers on Products & Services of the Bank: Keep updated regularly regarding features/requirements/charges of the products and services of the bank. Keep all relevant forms, brochures and information to educate customers for promoting bank’s product and services. Assist customer to complete any application. Achievement of Business Targets and Revenue Generation: Maintaining Acquisition of new business through effective customer communication and relationship and meet business targets as per given KPI. Preparation of loan and credit card applications and follow up with approval with related department (Credit & Collection). Cross selling all the bank's products. Realization of online charges & fees as per SOC. Proper usage and control of stationary and equipment to control the cost of the branch. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Cash Handling Customer Service Islamic Banking Regulatory Compliance

Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resource Management, Management or relevant discipline. Additional Requirements Age 24 to 32 years Only Male Experience Requirements: 1–3 years of experience in HR/Admin. Experience in recruitment, attendance, leave management and payroll support will be preferred. Freshers with strong interest in HR may also be considered. Additional Requirements: Good knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office. Good Bangla and English communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle employee matters professionally. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks. Responsibilities & Context Manage end-to-end recruitment activities including CV screening, interview coordination, selection and onboarding. Maintain employee personal files, attendance and leave records. Prepare and maintain monthly salary sheets and provide payroll-related support. Handle employee queries and provide necessary HR support. Prepare HR letters, notices, office notes and other HR-related documents. Maintain and update HR records and databases. Assist in employee confirmation, increment, final settlement and other HR processes. Support HR/Admin activities and ensure smooth day-to-day HR operations. Assist in implementing HR policies, procedures and employee engagement/organizational development initiatives. Perform other HR and administrative tasks as assigned by management. Undertake any other responsibilities or tasks assigned by the management from time to time. Working hours: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Candidates should have a responsible and committed mindset with the intention to work for at least one year. Skills & Expertise Bangla and English typing Human Resource Management Microsoft Office Recruitment & Selection Other Relevant Skills Administrative Support Employee Management HR Policy Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Two-time snacks and tea provided during office hours. Professional and supportive work environment. Opportunities for professional learning and career development. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Khilgaon)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535169&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, Business Administration, Textile, Industrial Engineering, or a relevant discipline. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Buying House, Garments Additional Requirements Age 25 to 28 years Only Male Strong reconciliation and quantitative analysis skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel/Office, particularly formulas, Pivot Tables, and data analysis. Basic understanding of dyeing, washing, dyes, and chemical consumption. Experience with OPEX and Lean Management will be an advantage. Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in the RMG/textile manufacturing sector. Strong understanding of reconciliation, quantitative analysis, and operational data. Responsibilities & Context Reconcile and trace garment quantities from cutting through shipment across different stages of production. Review production records and identify discrepancies between different production stages. Perform quantitative analysis and reconciliation of production-related data. Monitor the utilization and consumption of dyes and chemicals in Dyeing and Washing operations from an internal audit perspective. Compare actual consumption with relevant production requirements and identify unusual variations. Monitor non-moving and slow-moving inventory and prepare reports highlighting potential wastage or accumulation. Analyze inventory data and support management in minimizing inventory-related losses. Prepare regular audit findings, analytical reports, and management summaries. Maintain proper documentation and supporting records for audit observations. Work with production and operational teams to understand process gaps and support corrective actions. Assist in identifying opportunities for cost control, waste reduction, and process improvement. Support implementation and monitoring of OPEX and Lean Management practices where applicable. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Internal Audit Data Reconciliation Inventory Analysis Waste Reduction Cost control Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Other benefits as per company policy Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Narayanganj
